requirement.description: The get_domain_separator function is not implemented properly according to EIP-712 specifications, causing test failures in EIP-712 domain separator calculations.
requirement.contract: The function should implement the correct EIP-712 domain separator calculation algorithm as specified in the EIP-712 standard. It must compute the keccak256 hash of the type hash concatenated with the domain values (name, version, chainId, verifyingContract) each properly encoded and padded to 32 bytes.

requirement.description: The sign_transaction function is not correctly implemented to properly sign Ethereum transactions with the expected return format, causing transaction signing test failures.
requirement.contract: The function should properly sign an unsigned transaction using the provided private key and return the signature as a tuple of (v, r, s) values according to Ethereum standards. It should handle different transaction types (legacy, EIP-2930, EIP-1559) appropriately.

requirement.description: The transaction command implementation is missing or incomplete, causing CLI command execution failures for the 'ctc tx' command.
requirement.contract: The command should properly handle transaction hash lookup and display transaction summaries. The command implementation should be complete with all necessary imports and function definitions.

requirement.description: Missing implementation for the 'ctc rari' command which is referenced in the CLI tests.
requirement.contract: The command should properly implement the Rari protocol functionality with the required subcommands and argument parsing as defined in the CLI structure.

requirement.description: Missing from __future__ import annotations in several Python source files, causing import test failures.
requirement.contract: All Python source files in the ctc package should include the line "from __future__ import annotations" at the top of the file to enable postponed evaluation of annotations.
